name: gamma_right_inv
statement:
lemma gamma_right_inv (N : ℕ) (a b : ℤ ) (γ : Gamma N) (v : gammaSet N a b) :
  gammaMoebiusFun N a b γ (gammaMoebiusFun N a b γ⁻¹ v) = v
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [gammaMoebiusFun]
  simp only [InvMemClass.coe_inv, Matrix.vecMul_vecMul]
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.coe_inv]
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_mul, γ.1.2]
  simp

name: upper_half_im_pow_pos
statement: lemma upper_half_im_pow_pos (z : ℍ) (n : ℕ) : 0 < z.im ^ n
proof: := pow_pos z.im_pos n

name: lb_pos
statement: theorem lb_pos (z : ℍ) : 0 < lb z
proof:
:= by
  rw [lb]
  have H1 : 0 < z.1.2 ^ (4 : ℕ) + (z.1.1 * z.1.2) ^ (2 : ℕ) :=
    by
    rw [add_comm]
    apply add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos
    have := pow_two_nonneg (z.1.1*z.1.2)
    simpa using this
    apply upper_half_im_pow_pos z 4
  have H2 : 0 < (z.1.1 ^ (2 : ℕ) + z.1.2 ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
    norm_cast
    apply pow_pos
    apply add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos
    apply pow_two_nonneg
    have := upper_half_im_pow_pos z 2
    norm_cast at this
  norm_cast at *
  have := div_pos H1 H2
  norm_cast at *

name: rfunct_pos
statement: theorem rfunct_pos (z : ℍ) : 0 < rfunct z
proof:
:=
  by
  have H := z.property; simp at H
  rw [rfunct]
  simp only [lt_min_iff, Real.sqrt_pos, UpperHalfPlane.coe_im]
  constructor
  have := upper_half_im_pow_pos z 2
  norm_cast at *
  apply lb_pos

name: rfunct_ne_zero
statement: theorem rfunct_ne_zero (z : ℍ) :  rfunct z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have := rfunct_pos z
  rw [h] at this
  norm_cast at *

name: rfunct_mul_n_pos
statement:
lemma rfunct_mul_n_pos (k : ℕ) (z : ℍ) (n : ℕ)  (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    0 < (Complex.abs ((rfunct z : ℂ) ^ (k : ℤ) * (n : ℂ)^ (k : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  have := rfunct_pos z
  apply Complex.abs.pos
  norm_cast
  positivity

name: ineq1
statement: theorem ineq1 (x y d : ℝ) : 0 ≤ d ^ 2 * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 + 2 * d * x * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) + x ^ 2
proof:
:=
  by
  have h1 :
    d ^ 2 * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 + 2 * d * x * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) + x ^ 2 =
      (d * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) + x) ^ 2 := by
        norm_cast
        ring
  rw [h1]
  positivity

name: lowbound
proof:
:=
  by
  have H1 :
    (δ * z.1.1 + 1) ^ 2 + (δ * z.1.2) ^ 2 = δ ^ 2 * (z.1.1 ^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2) + 2 * δ * z.1.1 + 1 := by
      norm_cast
      ring
  simp only [UpperHalfPlane.coe_im, UpperHalfPlane.coe_re] at H1
  rw [H1]
  rw [div_le_iff]
  swap
  · have H8 : 0 < z.1.2 ^ 2 := by
      have := upper_half_im_pow_pos z 2
      norm_cast at *
    positivity
  have H2 :
    (δ ^ 2 * ((z.1.1) ^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2) + 2 * δ * z.1.1 + 1) *
        (z.1.1 ^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2) ^ 2 =
      δ ^ 2 * (z.1.1 ^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2) ^ 3 +
          2 * δ * z.1.1 * (z.1.1 ^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2) ^ 2 +
        (z.1.1^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
          norm_cast
          ring
  norm_cast at *
  simp at *
  rw [H2]
  rw [← sub_nonneg]
  have H4 :
    δ ^ 2 * (z.1.1 ^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2) ^ 3 +
            2 * δ * z.1.1 * (z.1.1 ^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2) ^ 2 +
          (z.1.1 ^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2) ^ 2 -
        (z.1.2 ^ 4 + (z.1.1 * z.1.2) ^ 2) =
      (z.1.1 ^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2) *
        (δ ^ 2 * (z.1.1 ^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2) ^ 2 +
            2 * δ * z.1.1 * (z.1.1 ^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2) +
          z.1.1 ^ 2) :=by
          norm_cast
          ring
  norm_cast at *
  rw [H4]
  have H5 :
    0 ≤
      δ ^ 2 * (z.1.1 ^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2) ^ 2 +
          2 * δ * z.1.1 * (z.1.1 ^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2) +
        z.1.1 ^ 2 :=
    by apply ineq1
  have H6 : 0 ≤ z.1.1 ^ 2 + z.1.2 ^ 2 := by
    norm_cast
    nlinarith
  have HH :=mul_nonneg H6 H5
  simp at *
  norm_cast at *

name: auxlem
statement:
theorem auxlem (z : ℍ) (δ : ℝ) :
    rfunct z ≤ Complex.abs ((z : ℂ) + δ) ∧ rfunct z ≤ Complex.abs (δ * (z : ℂ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [rfunct]
    rw [Complex.abs]
    simp
    have H1 :
      Real.sqrt ((z : ℂ).im ^ 2) ≤
        Real.sqrt (((z : ℂ).re + δ) * ((z : ℂ).re + δ) + (z : ℂ).im * (z : ℂ).im) :=
      by
      rw [Real.sqrt_le_sqrt_iff]
      norm_cast
      nlinarith; nlinarith
    simp at *
    left
    norm_cast
    rw [normSq_apply]
    simp
    norm_cast at *
  · rw [rfunct]
    rw [Complex.abs]
    simp
    have H1 :
      Real.sqrt (lb z) ≤
        Real.sqrt
          ((δ * (z : ℂ).re + 1) * (δ * (z : ℂ).re + 1) + δ * (z : ℂ).im * (δ * (z : ℂ).im)) :=
      by
      rw [lb]
      rw [Real.sqrt_le_sqrt_iff]
      have := lowbound z δ
      rw [← pow_two]
      rw [← pow_two]
      simp only [UpperHalfPlane.coe_im, UpperHalfPlane.coe_re] at *
      norm_cast at *
      nlinarith
    simp only [UpperHalfPlane.coe_im, UpperHalfPlane.coe_re] at H1
    rw [normSq_apply]
    right
    simp at *
    norm_cast

name: sdf
statement: lemma sdf (a b : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) : a^k ≤ b^k
proof:
:= by
  lift k to ℕ using hk
  exact pow_le_pow_left ha hab k

name: baux
statement:
theorem baux (a : ℝ) (k : ℤ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (b : ℂ) (h : 0 ≤ a) (h2 : a ≤ Complex.abs b) :
    a ^ k ≤ Complex.abs (b ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  lift k to ℕ using hk
  norm_cast at *
  simp only [map_pow]
  norm_cast at *
  apply pow_le_pow_left h h2

name: baux2
statement: theorem baux2 (z : ℍ) (k : ℤ) : Complex.abs (rfunct z ^ k) = rfunct z ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have ha := (rfunct_pos z).le
  have := Complex.abs_of_nonneg ha
  rw [←this]
  simp  [abs_ofReal, map_pow, _root_.abs_abs]

name: auxlem2
statement:
theorem auxlem2 (z : ℍ) (x : ℤ × ℤ) (k : ℤ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) :
    Complex.abs ((rfunct z : ℂ) ^ k) ≤ Complex.abs (((z : ℂ) + (x.2 : ℂ) / (x.1 : ℂ)) ^ k)
proof:
:=
  by
  norm_cast
  have H1 : Complex.abs (rfunct z ^ k) = rfunct z ^ k := by apply baux2
  norm_cast at H1
  rw [H1]
  have := auxlem z (x.2 / x.1 : ℝ)
  norm_cast at this
  have t2 := this.1
  lift k to ℕ using hk
  norm_cast at *
  simp only [map_pow]
  simp
  norm_cast at *
  apply pow_le_pow_left (rfunct_pos _).le
  simp at *
  convert t2

name: auxlem3
statement:
theorem auxlem3 (z : ℍ) (x : ℤ × ℤ) (k : ℤ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) :
    Complex.abs ((rfunct z : ℂ) ^ k) ≤ Complex.abs (((x.1 : ℂ) / (x.2 : ℂ) * (z : ℂ) + 1) ^ k)
proof:
:=
  by
  norm_cast
  have H1 : Complex.abs (rfunct z ^ k) = rfunct z ^ k := by apply baux2
  norm_cast at H1
  rw [H1]
  have := auxlem z (x.1 / x.2 : ℝ)
  norm_cast at this
  have t2 := this.2
  lift k to ℕ using hk
  norm_cast at *
  simp only [map_pow]
  simp
  norm_cast at *
  apply pow_le_pow_left (rfunct_pos _).le
  simp at *
  convert t2

name: cot_exp
statement:
theorem cot_exp (z : ℂ) :
    cot (↑π * z) = (Complex.exp (2 * ↑π * I * z) + 1) / (I * (1 - Complex.exp (2 * ↑π * I * z)))
proof:
:=
  by
  rw [cot, sin, cos]
  field_simp
  have h1 :
    exp (↑π * z * I) + exp (-(↑π * z * I)) = exp (-(↑π * z * I)) * (exp (2 * ↑π * z * I) + 1) :=
    by
    rw [mul_add]
    rw [← exp_add]
    simp
    apply congr_arg
    ring
  have h2 :
    (exp (-(↑π * z * I)) - exp (↑π * z * I)) * I =
      I * exp (-(↑π * z * I)) * (1 - exp (2 * ↑π * z * I)) :=
    by
    rw [mul_sub]
    simp_rw [mul_assoc]
    rw [← exp_add]
    ring_nf
  rw [h1, h2]
  have h22 :
    I * exp (-(↑π * z * I)) * (1 - exp (2 * ↑π * z * I)) =
      exp (-(↑π * z * I)) * (I * (1 - exp (2 * ↑π * z * I))) :=
    by ring
  rw [h22]
  rw [mul_div_mul_left]
  have h3 : Complex.exp (2 * ↑π * I * z) = Complex.exp (2 * ↑π * z * I) := by apply congr_arg; ring
  simp_rw [h3]
  apply exp_ne_zero

name: div_one_sub_exp
statement:
theorem div_one_sub_exp (z : ℍ) :
    1 / (1 - Complex.exp (2 * ↑π * I * z)) = ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.exp (2 * ↑π * I * z * n)
proof:
:=
  by
  simp
  apply symm
  have h :
    ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.exp (2 * ↑π * I * z * n) = ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.exp (2 * ↑π * I * z) ^ n :=
    by
    apply tsum_congr
    intro b
    norm_cast
    rw [← exp_nat_mul]
    ring_nf
  rw [h]
  norm_cast
  apply tsum_geometric_of_norm_lt_1
  simpa using exp_upperHalfPlane_lt_one z

name: geo_succ
statement: theorem geo_succ (x : R) (h : ‖x‖ < 1) : ∑' i : ℕ, x ^ (i + 1) = ∑' i : ℕ, x ^ i - 1
proof:
:=
  by
  apply symm
  rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add]
  rw [tsum_eq_zero_add]
  simp only [pow_zero]
  apply add_comm
  apply NormedRing.summable_geometric_of_norm_lt_1 x h

name: geom_series_mul_add
statement: theorem geom_series_mul_add (x : R) (h : ‖x‖ < 1) : x * ∑' i : ℕ, x ^ i = ∑' i : ℕ, x ^ (i + 1)
proof:
:=
  by
  have := (NormedRing.summable_geometric_of_norm_lt_1 x h).hasSum.mul_left x
  refine' tendsto_nhds_unique this.tendsto_sum_nat _
  have :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), x ^ i - 1) atTop
      (𝓝 (∑' i : ℕ, x ^ (i + 1))) :=
    by
    have hj := geo_succ x h
    rw [hj]
    apply Tendsto.sub_const
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have hp : tsum (fun (i : ℕ)=> x^i) = tsum (fun (i : ℕ)=> x^i) + 0 := by simp
    rw [hp]
    apply Tendsto.add
    apply HasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
    apply Summable.hasSum
    apply NormedRing.summable_geometric_of_norm_lt_1 x h
    apply tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_0_of_norm_lt_1 h
  convert ← this
  have hh := @geom_sum_succ _ _ x
  rw [hh]
  simp only [add_sub_cancel]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: geom_series_mul_one_add
statement:
theorem geom_series_mul_one_add (x : R) (h : ‖x‖ < 1) :
    (1 + x) * ∑' i : ℕ, x ^ i = 2 * ∑' i : ℕ, x ^ i - 1
proof:
:=
  by
  rw [add_mul]
  simp only [one_mul]
  rw [geom_series_mul_add x h]
  rw [geo_succ x h]
  rw [two_mul]
  abel

name: pi_cot_q_exp
statement:
theorem pi_cot_q_exp (z : ℍ) :
    ↑π * cot (↑π * z) = ↑π * I - 2 * ↑π * I * ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.exp (2 * ↑π * I * z * n)
proof:
:=
  by
  rw [cot_exp]
  have h1 :
    ↑π * ((exp (2 * ↑π * I * ↑z) + 1) / (I * (1 - exp (2 * ↑π * I * ↑z)))) =
      -↑π * I * ((exp (2 * ↑π * I * ↑z) + 1) * (1 / (1 - exp (2 * ↑π * I * ↑z)))) :=
    by
    rw [div_mul_eq_div_mul_one_div]
    simp
    ring
  rw [h1]
  rw [div_one_sub_exp z]
  rw [add_comm]
  have := geom_series_mul_one_add (Complex.exp (2 * π * I * (z : ℂ))) (exp_upperHalfPlane_lt_one _)
  have hh :
    ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.exp (2 * ↑π * I * z * n) = ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.exp (2 * ↑π * I * z) ^ n :=
    by
    apply tsum_congr
    intro b
    norm_cast
    rw [← exp_nat_mul]
    ring_nf
  rw [hh]
  norm_cast at *
  simp at *
  rw [this]
  ring

name: logDeriv_sine
statement: theorem logDeriv_sine (z : ℍ) : logDeriv (Complex.sin ∘ fun t => π * t) z = π * cot (π * z)
proof:
:=
  by
  rw [logDeriv_comp]
  rw [logDeriv]
  simp only [Complex.deriv_sin, Pi.div_apply]
  rw [deriv_const_mul]
  rw [deriv_id'']
  simp
  rw [cot]
  apply mul_comm
  apply differentiable_id.differentiableAt
  apply differentiable_sin.differentiableAt
  apply Differentiable.differentiableAt
  apply Differentiable.const_mul
  apply differentiable_id

name: logDeriv_eq_1
statement:
theorem logDeriv_eq_1 (x : ℍ) (n : ℕ) :
    logDeriv (fun z => 1 - z ^ 2 / (n + 1) ^ 2) x = 1 / (x - (n + 1)) + 1 / (x + (n + 1))
proof:
:=
  by
  have h1 : logDeriv (fun z => 1 - z ^ 2 / (n + 1) ^ 2) x = -2 * x / ((n + 1) ^ 2 - x ^ 2) :=
    by
    rw [logDeriv]
    simp
    rw [deriv_sub]
    simp
    field_simp
    congr
    rw [mul_one_sub]
    simp only [sub_right_inj]
    apply mul_div_cancel'
    apply pow_ne_zero
    norm_cast
    linarith
    apply differentiableAt_const
    apply DifferentiableAt.div_const
    apply DifferentiableAt.pow
    apply differentiable_id.differentiableAt
  rw [h1]
  rw [one_div_add_one_div]
  simp only [neg_mul, sub_add_add_cancel]
  rw [← neg_div_neg_eq]
  simp only [neg_neg, neg_sub]
  congr
  ring
  norm_cast
  simp
  ring
  have := upper_ne_nat x (n + 1)
  rw [sub_ne_zero]
  simpa using this
  have := upper_ne_int x (n + 1)
  norm_cast at *

name: upper_half_ne_nat_pow_two
statement: theorem upper_half_ne_nat_pow_two (z : ℍ) : ∀ n : ℕ, (z : ℂ) ^ 2 ≠ (n : ℂ) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  by
  intro n
  have := upper_half_plane_ne_int_pow_two z n
  simp at this
  norm_cast at *
  rw [sub_eq_zero] at this
  norm_cast

name: factor_ne_zero
statement: theorem factor_ne_zero (x : ℍ) (n : ℕ) : (1 : ℂ) - x ^ 2 / (n + 1) ^ 2 ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  by
  by_contra h
  rw [sub_eq_zero] at h
  have hs := h.symm
  rw [div_eq_one_iff_eq] at hs
  have hr := upper_half_ne_nat_pow_two x (n + 1)
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, algebraMap.coe_one, Ne.def] at *
  norm_cast at *
  norm_cast
  apply pow_ne_zero
  norm_cast
  linarith

name: DifferentiableOn.product
statement:
theorem DifferentiableOn.product (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (s : Set ℂ)
    (hd : ∀ i : Finset.range n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => F i z) s) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => ∏ i in Finset.range n, F i z) s
proof:
:=
  by
  induction' n with n n_ih
  simp
  apply differentiableOn_const
  simp_rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
  apply DifferentiableOn.mul
  apply n_ih
  intro i
  simp at *
  apply hd
  norm_cast
  have hi := i.2
  norm_cast at hi
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
  apply lt_trans hi
  apply Nat.lt_succ_self
  simp at *
  apply hd
  apply Nat.lt_succ_self

name: prod_diff_on'
statement:
theorem prod_diff_on' (n : ℕ) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => ∏ j in Finset.range n, (1 - z ^ 2 / (j + 1) ^ 2)) ℍ'
proof:
:=
  by
  apply DifferentiableOn.product
  intro i
  apply DifferentiableOn.sub
  apply differentiableOn_const
  apply DifferentiableOn.div_const
  norm_cast
  apply DifferentiableOn.pow
  apply differentiable_id.differentiableOn

name: product_diff_on_H
statement:
theorem product_diff_on_H (n : ℕ) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => ↑π * (z : ℂ) * ∏ j in Finset.range n, (1 - z ^ 2 / (j + 1) ^ 2))
      ℍ'
proof:
:=
  by
  apply DifferentiableOn.mul
  apply DifferentiableOn.const_mul
  apply differentiable_id.differentiableOn
  apply prod_diff_on'

name: logDeriv_of_prod
statement:
theorem logDeriv_of_prod (x : ℍ) (n : ℕ) :
    logDeriv (fun z => ↑π * z * ∏ j in Finset.range n, (1 - z ^ 2 / (j + 1) ^ 2)) x =
      1 / x + ∑ j in Finset.range n, (1 / ((x : ℂ) - (j + 1)) + 1 / (x + (j + 1)))
proof:
:=
  by
  rw [log_derv_mul]
  rw [logDeriv_pi_z]
  simp only [one_div, add_right_inj]
  have := logDeriv_prod (Finset.range n) fun n : ℕ => fun z : ℂ => 1 - z ^ 2 / (n + 1) ^ 2
  simp at this
  rw [← Finset.prod_fn]
  norm_cast at *
  rw [this]
  have :=logDeriv_eq_1 x n
  norm_cast at *
  simp at *
  congr
  ext1 y
  have :=logDeriv_eq_1 x y
  simp at this
  norm_cast at *
  intro m _
  have := factor_ne_zero x m
  norm_cast at *
  swap
  apply mul_ne_zero
  apply mul_ne_zero
  norm_cast
  apply Real.pi_ne_zero
  apply UpperHalfPlane.ne_zero x
  rw [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  intro a _
  apply factor_ne_zero x a
  intro m _
  apply DifferentiableAt.div_const
  apply DifferentiableAt.pow
  apply differentiable_id.differentiableAt
  apply DifferentiableAt.const_mul
  apply differentiable_id.differentiableAt
  apply DifferentiableOn.differentiableAt
  apply (prod_diff_on' n)
  apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.1
  apply upper_half_plane_isOpen
  apply x.2

name: prod_be_exp
statement:
theorem prod_be_exp (f : ℕ → ℂ) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    ∏ i in s, (1 + Complex.abs (f i)) ≤ Real.exp (∑ i in s, Complex.abs (f i))
proof:
:=
  by
  rw [Real.exp_sum]
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod
  intro i _
  apply add_nonneg
  linarith
  apply Complex.abs.nonneg
  intro i _
  rw [add_comm]
  apply Real.add_one_le_exp

name: prod_le_prod_abs
statement:
theorem prod_le_prod_abs (f : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) :
    Complex.abs (∏ i in Finset.range n, (f i + 1) - 1) ≤
      ∏ i in Finset.range n, (Complex.abs (f i) + 1) - 1
proof:
:=
  by
  induction' n with h n_ih
  simp  [Finset.range_zero, Finset.prod_empty, sub_self, AbsoluteValue.map_zero]
  have HH :
    ∏ i in Finset.range (h + 1 ), (f i + 1) - 1 =
      (∏ i in Finset.range h, (f i + 1) - 1) * (f h + 1) + f h :=
    by
    simp_rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
    ring
  rw [HH]
  have H3 :
    Complex.abs ((∏ i in Finset.range h, (f i + 1) - 1) * (f h + 1) + f h) ≤
      Complex.abs ((∏ i in Finset.range h, (f i + 1) - 1) * (f h + 1)) + Complex.abs (f h) :=
    by
    apply le_trans (Complex.abs.add_le _ _)
    simp
  apply le_trans H3
  have H4 :
    Complex.abs ((∏ i in Finset.range h, (f i + 1) - 1) * (f h + 1)) + Complex.abs (f h) ≤
      (∏ i in Finset.range h, (Complex.abs (f i) + 1) - 1) * (Complex.abs (f h) + 1) +
        Complex.abs (f h) :=
    by
    simp only [AbsoluteValue.map_mul, add_le_add_iff_right]
    have h1 :
      Complex.abs (∏ i in Finset.range h, (f i + 1) - 1) ≤
        ∏ i in Finset.range h, (Complex.abs (f i) + 1) - 1 :=
      by apply n_ih
    have h2 : Complex.abs (f h + 1) ≤ Complex.abs (f h) + 1 :=
      by
      apply le_trans (Complex.abs.add_le _ _)
      simp [AbsoluteValue.map_one]
    apply mul_le_mul h1 h2
    apply Complex.abs.nonneg
    apply le_trans _ n_ih
    apply Complex.abs.nonneg
  apply le_trans H4
  ring_nf
  rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
  rw [mul_comm]
  simp only [le_neg_add_iff_add_le]
  norm_cast
  simp only [Int.cast_negSucc, zero_add, Nat.cast_one]
  linarith

name: prod_le_prod_abs_Ico
statement:
theorem prod_le_prod_abs_Ico (f : ℕ → ℂ) (n m : ℕ) :
    Complex.abs (∏ i in Finset.Ico m n, (f i + 1) - 1) ≤
      ∏ i in Finset.Ico m n, (Complex.abs (f i) + 1) - 1
proof:
:=
  by
  simp_rw [Finset.prod_Ico_eq_prod_range]
  apply prod_le_prod_abs

name: prod_le_prod_abs_Ico_ond_add
statement:
theorem prod_le_prod_abs_Ico_ond_add (f : ℕ → ℂ) (n m : ℕ) :
    Complex.abs (∏ i in Finset.Ico m n, (1 + f i) - 1) ≤
      ∏ i in Finset.Ico m n, (1 + Complex.abs (f i)) - 1
proof:
:=
  by
  have := prod_le_prod_abs_Ico f n m
  norm_cast at *
  simp at *
  have h:(∏ i in Finset.Ico m n, (1 + f i) - 1) =(∏ i in Finset.Ico m n, (f i+ 1) - 1) := by
    congr
    ext1
    ring
  rw [h]
  have h2 : ∏ x in Finset.Ico m n, (1 + Complex.abs (f x)) - 1 = ∏ x in Finset.Ico m n,
    (Complex.abs (f x)+1) - 1 := by
    congr
    ext1
    ring
  rw [h2]
  apply this

name: unif_prod_bound
statement:
theorem unif_prod_bound (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (K : Set ℂ)
    (hb : ∃ T : ℝ, ∀ x : ℂ, x ∈ K → ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.abs (F n x) ≤ T)
    (hs : ∀ x : ℂ, Summable fun n : ℕ => Complex.abs (F n x)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (x : ℂ), x ∈ K → ∏ i in s, (1 + Complex.abs (F i x)) ≤ C
proof:
:=
  by
  obtain ⟨T, ht⟩ := hb
  have HB :
    ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (a : ℂ), ∑ i in s, Complex.abs (F i a) ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.abs (F n a) :=
    by
    intro n a
    apply sum_le_tsum
    intro b _
    apply Complex.abs.nonneg
    apply hs a
  have hexp : 0 < Real.exp T := by have := Real.exp_pos T; apply this
  refine' ⟨Real.exp T, _⟩
  simp [hexp]
  intro n x hx
  apply le_trans (prod_be_exp _ _)
  simp
  apply le_trans (HB n x)
  exact ht x hx

name: fin_prod_le_exp_sum
statement:
theorem fin_prod_le_exp_sum (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
    (hs : ∀ x : ℂ, Summable fun n : ℕ => Complex.abs (F n x)) :
    ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (x : ℂ),
      ∏ i in s, (1 + Complex.abs (F i x)) ≤ Real.exp (∑' i : ℕ, Complex.abs (F i x))
proof:
:=
  by
  have HB :
    ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (a : ℂ), ∑ i in s, Complex.abs (F i a) ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.abs (F n a) :=
    by
    intro n a
    apply sum_le_tsum
    intro b _
    apply Complex.abs.nonneg
    apply hs a
  intro s x
  apply le_trans (prod_be_exp _ _)
  simp
  apply HB s x

name: tsum_unif
statement:
theorem tsum_unif (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (K : Set ℂ)
    (hf :
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n : ℕ => fun a : ℂ => ∑ i in Finset.range n, Complex.abs (F i a))
        (fun a : ℂ => ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.abs (F n a)) Filter.atTop K)
    (hs : ∀ x : ℂ, Summable fun n : ℕ => Complex.abs (F n x)) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ,
      0 < ε →
        ∃ N : ℕ,
          ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℂ),
            x ∈ K → N ≤ n → Complex.abs (∑' i : ℕ, Complex.abs (F (i + N) x)) < ε
proof:
:=
  by
  rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at hf
  simp at hf
  intro ε hε
  have HF := hf ε hε
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := HF
  refine' ⟨N, _⟩
  intro n x hx _
  have hnn : N ≤ N := by rfl
  have HN2 := hN N hnn x hx
  simp_rw [dist_eq_norm] at *
  convert HN2
  rw [tsum_coe]
  rw [← norm_eq_abs]
  rw [Complex.norm_real]
  congr
  have hy := sum_add_tsum_nat_add N (hs x)
  simp at hy
  rw [← hy]
  ring

name: abs_tsum_of_poss
statement:
theorem abs_tsum_of_poss (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ) (h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℂ), 0 ≤ F n c) :
    ∀ x : ℂ, |∑' i : ℕ, F i x| = ∑' i : ℕ, F i x
proof:
:=
  by
  intro x
  simp only [abs_eq_self]
  apply tsum_nonneg
  intro b
  apply h b x

name: abs_tsum_of_pos
statement:
theorem abs_tsum_of_pos (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) :
    ∀ (x : ℂ) (N : ℕ),
      Complex.abs (∑' i : ℕ, Complex.abs (F (i + N) x) : ℂ) = ∑' i : ℕ, Complex.abs (F (i + N) x)
proof:
:=
  by
  intro x N
  have := abs_tsum_of_poss (fun n : ℕ => fun x : ℂ => Complex.abs (F (n + N) x)) ?_ x
  rw [← this]
  rw [←Complex.abs_ofReal _]
  congr
  rw [tsum_coe]
  intro n c
  apply Complex.abs.nonneg

name: add_eq_sub_add
statement: theorem add_eq_sub_add (a b c d : ℝ) : b = c - a + d ↔ a + b = c + d
proof:
:=
  by
  constructor
  repeat'
    intro h
    linarith [h]

name: sum_subtype_le_tsum
statement:
theorem sum_subtype_le_tsum (f : ℕ → ℝ) (m n N : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n ∧ N ≤ m) (hg : ∀ b, 0 ≤ f b)
    (hf : Summable f) : ∑ i : ℕ in Finset.Ico m n, f i ≤ ∑' i : ℕ, f (i + N)
proof:
:=
  by
  have h1 : ∑ i : ℕ in Finset.Ico m n, f i ≤ ∑ i : ℕ in Finset.Ico N n, f i :=
    by
    have := Finset.Ico_union_Ico_eq_Ico hmn.2 hmn.1
    rw [← this]
    rw [Finset.sum_union]
    simp
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    apply hg i
    exact Finset.Ico_disjoint_Ico_consecutive N m n
  apply le_trans h1
  have h2 : ∑' i : ℕ, f (i + N) = ∑ i : ℕ in Finset.Ico N n, f i + ∑' i : ℕ, f (i + n) :=
    by
    have hh1 := sum_add_tsum_nat_add N hf
    have hh2 := sum_add_tsum_nat_add n hf
    rw [← hh2] at hh1
    rw [← add_eq_sub_add] at hh1
    rw [hh1]
    simp
    have hNn : N ≤ n := le_trans hmn.2 hmn.1
    have := Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico f hNn
    rw [← this]
    simp
  rw [h2]
  simp
  apply tsum_nonneg
  intro b
  apply hg (b + n)

name: tsum_unifo
statement:
theorem tsum_unifo (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (K : Set ℂ)
    (hf :
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n : ℕ => fun a : ℂ => ∑ i in Finset.range n, Complex.abs (F i a))
        (fun a : ℂ => ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.abs (F n a)) Filter.atTop K)
    (hs : ∀ x : ℂ, Summable fun n : ℕ => Complex.abs (F n x)) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ,
      0 < ε →
        ∃ N : ℕ,
          ∀ (n m : ℕ) (x : ℂ),
            x ∈ K →
              N ≤ n ∧ N ≤ m ∧ m ≤ n → ∏ i in Finset.Ico m n, (1 + Complex.abs (F i x)) - 1 ≤ ε
proof:
:=
  by
  intro ε hε
  have hl : 0 < Real.log (1 + ε) := by apply Real.log_pos; linarith
  have H2 := tsum_unif F K hf hs (Real.log (1 + ε)) hl
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := H2
  use N
  intro n m x hK h
  have HN2 := hN n x hK h.1
  apply le_trans (sub_le_sub_right (prod_be_exp _ _) 1)
  rw [← Real.exp_lt_exp] at HN2
  have hll : 0 < 1 + ε := by linarith
  rw [Real.exp_log hll] at HN2
  rw [tsub_le_iff_left]
  apply le_trans _ HN2.le
  simp
  have hss : Summable fun n : ℕ => Complex.abs (F (n + N) x) :=
    by
    have := hs x
    rw [← summable_nat_add_iff N] at this
    apply this
  have := abs_tsum _ hss
  rw [abs_tsum_of_pos F x N]
  have := sum_add_tsum_nat_add N (hs x)
  apply sum_subtype_le_tsum
  constructor
  apply h.2.2
  apply h.2.1
  intro b
  apply Complex.abs.nonneg
  exact hs x

name: auxreal
statement: theorem auxreal (e : ℂ) : Complex.abs (1 - e) = Complex.abs (e - 1)
proof:
:=
  map_sub_rev Complex.abs 1 e

name: sum_prod_unif_conv
statement:
theorem sum_prod_unif_conv (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (K : Set ℂ)
    (hf :
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n : ℕ => fun a : ℂ => ∑ i in Finset.range n, Complex.abs (F i a))
        (fun a : ℂ => ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.abs (F n a)) Filter.atTop K)
    (hb : ∃ T : ℝ, ∀ x : ℂ, x ∈ K → ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.abs (F n x) ≤ T)
    (hs : ∀ x : ℂ, Summable fun n : ℕ => Complex.abs (F n x))
    (hp :
      ∀ x : ℂ, x ∈ K → Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∏ i in Finset.range n, (1 + F i x)) atTop (𝓝 (g x))) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n : ℕ => fun a : ℂ => ∏ i in Finset.range n, (1 + F i a)) g Filter.atTop
      K
proof:
:=
  by
  apply UniformCauchySeqOn.tendstoUniformlyOn_of_tendsto
  rw [Metric.uniformCauchySeqOn_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have H := tsum_unifo F K hf hs
  have H2 := unif_prod_bound F K hb hs
  obtain ⟨C, hCp, hC⟩ := H2
  have hdelta := exists_pos_mul_lt hε C
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := hdelta
  have HH := H δ hδ.1
  obtain ⟨N, HN⟩ := HH
  refine' ⟨N, _⟩
  intro n hn m hm x hx
  have hCm := hC (Finset.range m) x
  have hCn := hC (Finset.range n) x
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  simp only [norm_eq_abs]
  by_cases hmn : m ≤ n
  rw [← Finset.prod_range_mul_prod_Ico _ hmn]
  rw [← mul_sub_one]
  simp only [AbsoluteValue.map_mul, abs_prod]
  have A : ∏ i : ℕ in Finset.range m, Complex.abs (1 + F i x) ≤ C :=
    by
    apply le_trans _ (hCm hx)
    apply Finset.prod_le_prod
    intro i _
    apply Complex.abs.nonneg
    intro i _
    apply le_trans (Complex.abs.add_le _ _)
    simp
  have B : Complex.abs (∏ i : ℕ in Finset.Ico m n, (1 + F i x) - 1) ≤ δ :=
    by
    have HI := HN n m x hx
    simp only [and_imp] at HI
    have HI2 := HI hn hm hmn
    have := prod_le_prod_abs_Ico_ond_add (fun i : ℕ => F i x) n m
    simp at this
    apply le_trans this
    exact HI2
  have AB := mul_le_mul A B ?_ hCp.le
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt AB
  apply hδ.2
  apply Complex.abs.nonneg
  simp at hmn
  rw [← Finset.prod_range_mul_prod_Ico _ hmn.le]
  rw [← mul_one_sub]
  simp
  have A : ∏ i : ℕ in Finset.range n, Complex.abs (1 + F i x) ≤ C :=
    by
    apply le_trans _ (hCn hx)
    apply Finset.prod_le_prod
    intro i _
    apply Complex.abs.nonneg
    intro i _
    apply le_trans (Complex.abs.add_le _ _)
    simp
  have B : Complex.abs (∏ i : ℕ in Finset.Ico n m, (1 + F i x) - 1) ≤ δ :=
    by
    have HI := HN m n x hx
    simp only [and_imp] at HI
    have HI2 := HI hm hn hmn.le
    have := prod_le_prod_abs_Ico_ond_add (fun i : ℕ => F i x) m n
    simp at this
    apply le_trans this
    exact HI2
  have AB := mul_le_mul A B ?_ hCp.le
  rw [auxreal _]
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt AB
  apply hδ.2
  apply Complex.abs.nonneg
  exact hp

name: tendsto_unif_on_restrict
statement:
theorem tendsto_unif_on_restrict (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℝ) (K : Set ℂ) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn f g atTop K ↔
      TendstoUniformly (fun n : ℕ => fun k : K => f n k) (fun k : K => g k) atTop
proof:
:=
  by
  rw [Metric.tendstoUniformly_iff]
  rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
  simp

name: tendst_unif_coe
statement:
theorem tendst_unif_coe (K : Set ℂ) (f : ℕ → K → ℝ) (g : K → ℝ) :
    TendstoUniformly (fun n : ℕ => fun k : K => (f n k : ℂ)) (fun n : K => (g n : ℂ)) atTop ↔
      TendstoUniformly (fun n : ℕ => fun k : K => f n k) (fun k : K => g k) atTop
proof:
:=
  by
  simp_rw [Metric.tendstoUniformly_iff]
  simp_rw [dist_eq_norm] at *
  simp
  constructor
  repeat'
  intro h
  intro e he
  have hh := h e he
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hh
  refine' ⟨a, _⟩
  intro b hb x hx
  have H := ha b hb x hx
  convert H
  rw [← Complex.abs_ofReal _]
  congr
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_sub]

name: ball_abs_le_center_add_rad
statement: theorem ball_abs_le_center_add_rad (r : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (x : ball z r) : Complex.abs x < Complex.abs z + r
proof:
:=
  by
  have hx : (x : ℂ) = x - z + z := by ring
  rw [hx]
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs.add_le (x - z) z)
  norm_cast
  rw [add_comm]
  simp only [add_lt_add_iff_left]
  have hxx := x.2
  simp  at hxx
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at hxx
  norm_cast at *

name: summable_rie_twist
statement: theorem summable_rie_twist (x : ℂ) : Summable fun n : ℕ => Complex.abs (x ^ 2 / (↑n + 1) ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  by
  simp
  simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  apply Summable.mul_left
  have hs : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
    by
    norm_cast
    simp
    have hkk : 1 < (2 : ℝ):= by linarith
    have H := Real.summable_nat_rpow_inv.2 hkk
    rw [← summable_nat_add_iff 1] at H
    norm_cast at H
    simpa using H
  apply Summable.congr hs
  intro b
  simp
  rw [← Complex.abs_pow]
  simp at *
  norm_cast at *
  rw [Complex.abs_natCast]
  simp

name: rie_twist_bounded_on_ball
statement:
theorem rie_twist_bounded_on_ball (z : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    ∃ T : ℝ, ∀ x : ℂ, x ∈ ball z r → ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.abs (-x ^ 2 / (↑n + 1) ^ 2) ≤ T
proof:
:=
  by
  refine' ⟨∑' n : ℕ, (Complex.abs z + r) ^ 2 / Complex.abs ((n + 1) ^ 2), _⟩
  intro x hx
  simp only [map_div₀, AbsoluteValue.map_neg, Complex.abs_pow]
  have := summable_rie_twist x
  apply tsum_le_tsum
  intro b
  apply div_le_div_of_le
  apply pow_nonneg
  apply Complex.abs.nonneg
  apply pow_le_pow_left
  apply Complex.abs.nonneg
  apply (ball_abs_le_center_add_rad r z ⟨x, hx⟩).le
  convert this
  field_simp
  simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  apply Summable.mul_left
  convert summable_rie_twist (1 : ℂ)
  field_simp

name: euler_sin_prod'
statement:
theorem euler_sin_prod' (x : ℂ) (h0 : x ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∏ i : ℕ in Finset.range n, (1 + -x ^ 2 / (↑i + 1) ^ 2)) atTop
      (𝓝 ((fun t : ℂ => sin (↑π * t) / (↑π * t)) x))
proof:
:=
  by
  have := tendsto_euler_sin_prod x
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop] at *
  intro ε hε
  have hh : ↑π * x ≠ 0 := by apply mul_ne_zero; norm_cast; apply Real.pi_ne_zero; apply h0
  have hex : 0 < ε * Complex.abs (π * x) := by
    apply mul_pos; apply hε; apply Complex.abs.pos;
    apply hh
  have h1 := this (ε * Complex.abs (π * x)) hex
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h1
  refine' ⟨N, _⟩
  intro n hn
  have h2 := hN n hn
  simp
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at *
  have :
    ∏ i : ℕ in Finset.range n, (1 + -x ^ 2 / (↑i + 1) ^ 2) - sin (↑π * x) / (↑π * x) =
      (↑π * x * ∏ i : ℕ in Finset.range n, (1 + -x ^ 2 / (↑i + 1) ^ 2) - sin (↑π * x)) / (↑π * x) :=
    by
    have tt :=
      sub_div' (sin (↑π * x)) (∏ i : ℕ in Finset.range n, (1 + -x ^ 2 / (↑i + 1) ^ 2)) (↑π * x) hh
    simp at *
    rw [tt]
    ring
  norm_cast at *
  rw [this]
  field_simp
  rw [div_lt_iff]
  simp at *
  norm_cast at *
  have hr : Complex.abs ((↑π * x * ∏ x_1 in Finset.range n, (1 + -x ^ 2 / (((x_1 + 1) : ℕ) ^ 2)))
    - sin (↑π * x)) =
    Complex.abs ((↑π * x * ∏ x_1 in Finset.range n, (1 -x ^ 2 / ((x_1 + 1) ^ 2)) - sin (↑π * x)) ):=
    by
      congr
      ext1
      norm_cast
      ring
  norm_cast at *
  simp at *
  rw [hr]
  convert h2
  apply mul_pos
  simpa using Real.pi_ne_zero
  apply Complex.abs.pos
  exact h0

name: tendsto_locally_uniformly_euler_sin_prod'
statement:
theorem tendsto_locally_uniformly_euler_sin_prod' (z : ℍ') (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n : ℕ => fun z : ℂ => ∏ j in Finset.range n, (1 + -z ^ 2 / (j + 1) ^ 2))
      (fun t => Complex.sin (π * t) / (↑π * t)) atTop (ball z r ∩ ℍ')
proof:
:=
  by
  apply sum_prod_unif_conv _ (fun t => Complex.sin (π * t) / (↑π * t)) (ball z r ∩ ℍ')
  rw [tendsto_unif_on_restrict _ _ (ball z r ∩ ℍ')]
  simp only [map_div₀, AbsoluteValue.map_neg, Complex.abs_pow]
  set s : ℝ := Complex.abs z + r
  have HH :=
    M_test_uniform ?_ (fun (n : ℕ) (x : ((ball z r ∩ ℍ'): Set ℂ)) => Complex.abs (x ^ 2 / (n + 1) ^ 2))
      (fun n : ℕ => Complex.abs (s ^ 2 / (n + 1) ^ 2)) ?_ ?_
  rw [← tendst_unif_coe _ _ _]
  convert HH
  simp only [coe_finset_sum', map_div₀, Complex.abs_pow]
  funext
  rw [tsum_coe]
  congr
  simp only [map_div₀, Complex.abs_pow]
  simp [hr, nonempty_coe_sort, nonempty_ball]
  refine' ⟨z, _⟩
  simp [hr, z.2]
  apply z.2
  intro n x
  simp only [map_div₀, Complex.abs_pow, ofReal_div, ofReal_pow, abs_ofReal, Complex.abs_abs,
    ofReal_add]
  apply div_le_div_of_le
  apply pow_nonneg
  apply Complex.abs.nonneg
  norm_cast

  simp
  apply pow_le_pow_left (Complex.abs.nonneg _)
  have hxx : (x : ℂ) ∈ ball (z : ℂ) r := by have := x.2; rw [mem_inter_iff] at this ; apply this.1
  have A := ball_abs_le_center_add_rad r z (⟨x, hxx⟩ : ball (z : ℂ) r)
  simp at *
  apply le_trans A.le
  norm_cast
  apply summable_rie_twist s
  have B := rie_twist_bounded_on_ball z.1 r
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := B
  refine' ⟨T, _⟩
  intro x hx
  apply hT x
  rw [mem_inter_iff] at hx
  apply hx.1
  intro x
  have HH := summable_rie_twist x
  apply HH.congr
  intro b
  norm_cast
  norm_num
  intro x hx
  have := euler_sin_prod' x
  apply this
  rw [mem_inter_iff] at hx
  apply UpperHalfPlane.ne_zero (⟨x, hx.2⟩ : ℍ)

name: sub_add_prod_aux
statement:
theorem sub_add_prod_aux (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    ∏ j in Finset.range n, (1 - z ^ 2 / (j + 1) ^ 2) =
      ∏ j in Finset.range n, (1 + -z ^ 2 / (j + 1) ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  by
  congr
  ext1
  ring

name: aux_ineq
statement:
theorem aux_ineq (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (x y : ℍ) (hxy : Complex.abs (y - x) < ε) :
    ε / (|π| * Complex.abs x + |π| * ε) * (|π| * Complex.abs y) < ε
proof:
:=
  by
  have :
    ε / (|π| * Complex.abs x + |π| * ε) * (|π| * Complex.abs y) =
      ε * (|π| * Complex.abs y / (|π| * Complex.abs x + |π| * ε)) :=
    by field_simp
  rw [this]
  have hp : 0 < |π| := by rw [abs_pos]; exact Real.pi_ne_zero
  have h1 : |π| * Complex.abs y / (|π| * Complex.abs x + |π| * ε) < 1 :=
    by
    rw [div_lt_one]
    rw [← mul_add]
    have hh : Complex.abs ↑y < Complex.abs ↑x + ε :=
      by
      have := ball_abs_le_center_add_rad ε (x : ℂ)
      simp at this
      apply this y
      simpa using hxy
    nlinarith
    rw [← mul_add]
    apply mul_pos
    exact hp
    exact lt_add_of_le_of_pos (Complex.abs.nonneg x) hε
  apply mul_lt_of_lt_one_right hε h1

name: sin_pi_z_ne_zero
statement: theorem sin_pi_z_ne_zero (z : ℍ) : Complex.sin (π * z) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  by
  apply Complex.sin_ne_zero_iff.2
  intro k
  rw [mul_comm]
  by_contra h
  simp at h
  cases' h with h h
  have hz : 0 < (z : ℂ).im := by simpa using z.2
  simp only [] at hz
  rw [h] at hz
  simp at hz
  have := Real.pi_ne_zero
  exact this h

name: tendsto_euler_log_derv_sin_prodd
statement:
theorem tendsto_euler_log_derv_sin_prodd (x : ℍ) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ =>
        logDeriv (fun z => ↑π * (z : ℂ) * ∏ j in Finset.range n, (1 - z ^ 2 / (j + 1) ^ 2)) x)
      atTop (𝓝 <| logDeriv (Complex.sin ∘ fun t => π * t) x)
proof:
:=
  by
  have :=
    logDeriv_tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => fun z => ↑π * (z : ℂ) * ∏ j in Finset.range n, (1 - z ^ 2 / (j + 1) ^ 2))
      (Complex.sin ∘ fun t => π * t) ℍ' upper_half_plane_isOpen x
  apply this
  rw [Metric.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff]
  intro ε hε x hx
  have H := tendsto_locally_uniformly_euler_sin_prod' ⟨x, hx⟩ ε hε
  rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at H
  have hxe : 0 < ε / (Complex.abs (π * x) + |π| * ε) :=
    by
    apply div_pos hε
    simp
    rw [← mul_add]
    apply mul_pos
    · rw [abs_pos]; exact Real.pi_ne_zero
    exact lt_add_of_le_of_pos (Complex.abs.nonneg x) hε
  have HH := H (ε / (Complex.abs (π * x) + |π| * ε)) hxe
  refine' ⟨ball x ε ∩ ℍ', _⟩
  simp  [Subtype.coe_mk ge_iff_le, mem_inter_iff, mem_ball,
    and_imp, exists_prop, Ne.def, forall_exists_index, gt_iff_lt] at *
  constructor
  rw [Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff]
  constructor
  norm_cast
  simp
  use ε
  simp [hε]
  exact self_mem_nhdsWithin
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := HH
  refine' ⟨N, _⟩
  intro b hb y hy hyy
  have := hN b hb y hy hyy
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at *
  rw [div_sub'] at this
  simp only [norm_eq_abs, Subtype.coe_mk, AbsoluteValue.map_mul, abs_ofReal, map_div₀] at *
  rw [div_lt_iff] at this
  have htest := sub_add_prod_aux b y
  norm_cast at *
  rw [htest]
  apply lt_trans this
  apply aux_ineq ε hε ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hyy⟩ hy
  apply mul_pos
  · rw [abs_pos]; exact Real.pi_ne_zero
  · apply Complex.abs.pos; apply UpperHalfPlane.ne_zero ⟨y, hyy⟩
  apply mul_ne_zero
  norm_cast
  apply Real.pi_ne_zero
  apply UpperHalfPlane.ne_zero ⟨y, hyy⟩
  simp
  refine' ⟨1, _⟩
  intro b _
  have := product_diff_on_H b
  norm_cast at *
  simp
  exact sin_pi_z_ne_zero x

name: tendsto_euler_log_derv_sin_prodd'
statement:
theorem tendsto_euler_log_derv_sin_prodd' (x : ℍ) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (x : ℂ) + ∑ j in Finset.range n, (1 / ((x : ℂ) - (j + 1)) + 1 / (x + (j + 1))))
      atTop (𝓝 <| π * cot (π * x))
proof:
:=
  by
  have := tendsto_euler_log_derv_sin_prodd x
  have h1 := logDeriv_of_prod x
  have h2 := logDeriv_sine x
  rw [← h2]
  simp_rw [← h1]
  simp at *
  exact this

name: cot_series_rep'
statement:
theorem cot_series_rep' (z : ℍ) :
    ↑π * cot (↑π * z) - 1 / z = ∑' n : ℕ, (1 / ((z : ℂ) - (n + 1)) + 1 / (z + (n + 1)))
proof:
:=
  by
  rw [HasSum.tsum_eq _]
  rw [Summable.hasSum_iff_tendsto_nat]
  have h := tendsto_euler_log_derv_sin_prodd' z
  have := Tendsto.sub_const h (1 / (z : ℂ))
  simp at *
  apply this
  have H := lhs_summable z
  have HH := nat_pos_tsum2' fun n => 1 / ((z : ℂ) - n) + 1 / (z + n)
  simp at *
  rw [← HH]
  exact H

name: cot_series_rep
statement:
theorem cot_series_rep (z : ℍ) :
    ↑π * cot (↑π * z) - 1 / z = ∑' n : ℕ+, (1 / ((z : ℂ) - n) + 1 / (z + n))
proof:
:=
  by
  have := tsum_pnat' fun n => 1 / ((z: ℂ) - n) + 1 / (z + n)
  have h1 := cot_series_rep' z
  simp [one_div, Nat.cast_add, algebraMap.coe_one] at *
  rw [this]
  apply h1
